name: evidence-lab-operations
description: Internal Evidence Lab operations pack for converting incoming work into executable task cards and maintaining a deterministic per-owner queue.

interface.shortDescription: Create and rank executable Evidence Lab tasks.
interface.longDescription: Turns raw requests into consistent task cards, verifies their fields, and maintains a gated per-owner execution order without losing completion history.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create these Evidence Lab tasks, assign the required fields, and update the execution order.
